analysis_scope.secondary: all30 including3 explicitly labeled known-pilot replications
analysis_scope.baseline_known_failure: Task1/init2 (300steps) remains included; report both lostCleanSuccess and gainedCleanFailure.

mechanism_followup_threshold.meaning: Entry criterion for subsequent fixed-candidate mechanism/defense work only, not statistical confirmation. Otherwise stop this cyclic construction.

analysis_scope.candidate_scope: Only before first executed-action divergence, while initial physical state+identical priorcontrols and recorded observedprefix are matched. Verify both candidateaction tensors exact; exclude post-divergence candidates from fixed-candidate flip denominator.
